_interiorNote: SOLE, THRESHOLD, STAIRS, INTERACT and BLOCKERS are generated by Art/rowhouseUnitIsoRig.js off the same layout the bake draws, through Art/_buildingGameplay.js. Furniture geometry is PropIso's — see propsDerivedFromRigSha256.

_excluded.ELEVATOR: A terrace is walk-up by definition: every unit has its own street door and its own private stair. Elevator, lobby, corridor, shared laundry and basement lockers belong to the walk-up block rig, not here.
_excluded.CORRIDOR: No shared circulation exists — unit doors open straight onto the street.
_excluded.LOBBY: Same: there is no shared entrance to model.
_excluded.walkable_roof: Flat membrane behind a parapet, no ladder and no hatch — basic terraces are not walkable up top.
_excluded.rear_garden: The rig bakes the building, not its plot. Yards, bins and bike racks are site dressing placed by the scene.

_confirm.resident_slots: UNITS[].resident_slots is the count of SLEEP anchors the interior actually built (one per approachable bed side), so a double seats two. nominal_occupancy is the figure units() derives from the bed request; the two differ when a plate cap trims a bedroom. Trust resident_slots — it is the one backed by a bed in a room.
_confirm.bedsBuilt: A plate holds two bedrooms, so a 3-bed unit needs three storeys; a 2-storey 3-bed request builds two and reports it (interior rig bedsBuilt / bedsRequested).
_confirm.mail: Luxury units carry no wall box — a recessed entry takes a slot in the door, which is not modelled. MAIL is omitted rather than invented.
_confirm.entry_swing: Street doors are given a 95 degree outward swing and its swept rect. The bake draws the leaf shut, so the arc is declared, not measured off pixels.
